functions.speed_builders_start:
title @a title [{fallback:"Build!",translate:"mcp.speed_builders_start.1",color:"dark_red",bold:1b,type:"translatable"}]
playsound minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup master @a ~ ~ ~ 10 2 1
scoreboard players set playingSpeedBuilders variables 1
scoreboard players set @a[gamemode=adventure] Points 3
scoreboard players operation finishThreshold variables = players variables
execute unless score doubles_mode variables matches 1 if score players variables matches ..7 run scoreboard players remove finishThreshold variables 1
execute unless score doubles_mode variables matches 1 if score players variables matches 8.. run scoreboard players remove finishThreshold variables 2
execute if score doubles_mode variables matches 1 run scoreboard players operation finishThreshold variables /= 2 constants

execute if score players variables matches 1 if score difficulty variables matches 1 run scoreboard players operation timeLeft variables *= 8 constants
